definitions.explanation: What can be seen from a particular location; the visual scene that spreads before one's eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{眺|なが}め⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The view from this room is the best.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{眺|なが}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: We enjoyed the view from the mountain top.

examples.japanese: {眺|なが}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧。
examples.english: I made a reservation at a restaurant with a nice view.
examples.notes: {眺|なが}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ = with a good view

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{眺|なが}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていて→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よかった→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The ocean view stretched out from the window, and it felt wonderful.

notes:
USAGE: {眺|なが}め is the noun form of the verb ⟦{眺|なが}める→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧ (to gaze at, to look out over). It emphasizes the visual experience of looking at scenery from a vantage point.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {眺|なが}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (has a good view)
- {眺|なが}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ (to enjoy the view)
- 〜⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{眺|なが}め (the view from ~)
- {眺|なが}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧ (room with a view)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧ - scenery, landscape (general)
- ⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧ - scenery, landscape (more formal/literary)
- ⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧ - scene, sight (can include events)
- ⟦{展望|てんぼう}→展望：12393_tenbou⟧ - outlook, view (often from observation points)
